Now I need to understand how the target is built and what the actual crash mechanism is. Let me check if there's a build script or if the target is already built:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.sh" -o -name "build*" -o -name "Dockerfile*" | grep -v libfuzzer | grep -v honggfuzz | head -20 && echo "---" && find /workspace/repo-vul -type f -executable | grep -v libfuzzer | grep -v honggfuzz | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
